Description: Allows for **TP Gauge** accumulation upon landing certain weaponskill combos.
Allows for **Familiar TP Gauge** accumulation upon the landing of auto-attacks or **Aetheric Burst**.
Grants the effect of **One with Nature** upon summoning a familiar.
Grants 1 stack of **Natural Instinct** upon completing a combo with a familiar instinctual skill.
Grants 1 stack of **Mastered Instinct** upon completing a combo with a beastmaster instinctual skill.

Allows the accumulation of charges for consecutive uses of **Shield Charge**.
**Maximum Charges:** 3
Increases the potency of **Smash Axe** to 160 and **Shield Charge** to 300.
Resets the recast timer for **Tempered Release** upon summoning a familiar.
Resets the recast timer for **Borrow** upon summoning a familiar.
Reduces **Rallying Cheer** recast time to 90 seconds.
Upgrades **Avalanche Axe** to **Brutal Rage**, **Mistral Axe** to **Hawkish Talons**, **Spinning Axe** to **Risen Fall**, and **Gale Axe** to **Calamity** upon accumulating 250 TP.
